cookies.description: Used to distinguish unique users and calculate visitor, session and campaign data.
Stores and updates a unique value for each page visited to generate statistical data.
Used by Google Analytics to throttle request rate.
Used by Meta/Facebook to deliver advertisement products such as real-time bidding.
Contains encrypted Facebook ID and browser identifier for cross-site behavioral retargeting.
Used by Google DoubleClick to register and report user actions after viewing or clicking ads.
Used to check if the user's browser supports cookies.
Stores and combines pageviews by a user into a single session recording.
Hotjar cookie that is set when the customer first lands on a page with the Hotjar script.
Essential server session identifier required to maintain authenticated state.
Cloudflare security cookies to manage incoming malicious bot traffic.
Stores user consent preferences across browsing sessions.
Remembers user display, language, or currency preferences.
Used widely by Microsoft as a unique user ID to track visitors across domains.
Keeps track of visitor identity and behavioral interactions for CRM retargeting.
